def.short: very soon; probably in the next few minutes
def.long: Very soon, probably in the next few minutes. People say it when they are waiting for something and expect it to happen soon.

grammar.pattern: will / should / be going to ... any minute now

examples.en: The bus will be here any minute now.
examples.tr: Otobüs her an gelebilir.

examples.en: Take your umbrella. It's going to rain any minute now.
examples.tr: Şemsiyeni al. Her an yağmur başlayabilir.

examples.en: Leyla's plane has landed, so she should call us any minute now.
examples.tr: Leyla'nın uçağı indi, birazdan bizi arar.

tr.note: Türkçede 'her an' bazen 'her zaman' anlamına da gelir ('her an yanındayım'). Bu İngilizce ifade ise yalnızca 'çok yakında olacak' demektir.

quiz.cloze: Hurry up! The train is leaving ______. The doors are closing.

entries.sense_note: very late, just before the time

def.micro: just before it is too late
def.short: very late, just before something starts or before it is too late
def.long: Very late, just before an event starts or just before it is too late to do something. People often use it about plans that change.

grammar.pattern: do something at the last minute

examples.en: Our flight was cancelled at the last minute.
examples.tr: Uçuşumuz son dakikada iptal edildi.

examples.en: Burak always packs his bag at the last minute.
examples.tr: Burak çantasını hep son dakikada hazırlar.

examples.en: We changed our plans at the last minute because of the storm.
examples.tr: Fırtına yüzünden planlarımızı son dakikada değiştirdik.

collocations: leave it to the last minute

tr.note: Sıfat olarak da kullanılır: a last-minute change (son dakika değişikliği).

mistakes.wrong: She arrived in the last minute.
mistakes.right: She arrived at the last minute.
mistakes.why: Türkçedeki '-da' eki yüzünden 'in' denir. 'Son anda' anlamında 'at' kullanılır. 'In the last minute' yalnızca bir maçın son dakikası gibi gerçek bir dakikayı anlatır.

quiz.cloze: Ece never plans ahead. She bought her train ticket ______, ten minutes before it left.

def.micro: on one day, not the next
def.short: once every two days, for example on Monday, Wednesday and Friday
def.long: Once every two days: you do something one day, skip the next day, then do it again. People use it for habits like sport or watering plants.

examples.en: I go swimming every other day.
examples.tr: Gün aşırı yüzmeye gidiyorum.

examples.en: It rained every other day in April.
examples.tr: Nisanda gün aşırı yağmur yağdı.

examples.en: Tom runs every other day. He ran yesterday, so today is his rest day.
examples.tr: Tom gün aşırı koşuyor. Dün koştu, yani bugün dinlenme günü.

tr.note: Aynı mantıkla 'every other week' iki haftada bir, 'every other month' iki ayda bir demektir.

quiz.cloze: I ran on Monday and Wednesday, and I'll run again on Friday. I run ______.

def.micro: not going to arrive on time
def.short: behind your plan, so you will arrive after the agreed time
def.long: Behind your plan, so you will arrive after the time you agreed. People often say it in a call or a message to the person who is waiting.

grammar.pattern: I'm / we're / the bus is running late

examples.en: Sorry, I'm running late. I'll be there in ten minutes.
examples.tr: Kusura bakma, geç kalıyorum. On dakikaya oradayım.

examples.en: The snow is very heavy, so the buses are running late today.
examples.tr: Kar çok yoğun yağıyor, o yüzden otobüsler bugün gecikiyor.

examples.en: Text Deniz and tell her we're running late because of the rain.
examples.tr: Deniz'e mesaj at, yağmur yüzünden geciktiğimizi söyle.

tr.note: Genelde hâlâ yoldayken, plandan geride olduğunu söylemek için kullanılır: 'I'm running late' (geç kalıyorum). 'I'm late' ise genel olarak 'geç kaldım' demektir; yolda da, varınca da söylenir.

quiz.cloze: Start the meeting without me. My train is delayed, so I'm ______.

def.short: the hours, days or years seem to pass very quickly
def.long: We say this when the hours, days or years seem to go very fast, often because we are busy or happy. People often add 'when you're having fun'.

examples.en: Summer is over already. Time flies!
examples.tr: Yaz bitti bile. Zaman su gibi geçiyor!

examples.en: Time flies when you're having fun!
examples.tr: Eğlenirken zaman su gibi geçer!

examples.en: Your son is ten already? Wow, time flies!
examples.tr: Oğlun on yaşına mı geldi? Vay be, zaman su gibi geçiyor!

tr.note: Genelde biraz şaşırarak söylenir. 'Time flies when you're having fun' (eğlenirken zaman çabuk geçer) kalıbı da çok yaygındır.

quiz.cloze: We talked for hours, but it felt like ten minutes. ______!

def.short: with thick, low cloud in the air, so you cannot see far
def.long: When the air near the ground is full of thick, wet cloud, the weather is like this. You cannot see far, so driving can be dangerous.

examples.en: It's very foggy this morning.
examples.tr: Bu sabah hava çok sisli.

examples.en: On foggy days, Emre drives slowly and uses his lights.
examples.tr: Sisli günlerde Emre yavaş sürer ve farlarını yakar.

examples.en: It was so foggy that we couldn't see the bridge from the hotel.
examples.tr: Hava o kadar sisliydi ki otelden köprüyü göremedik.

tr.note: İsmi 'fog' (sis) olur. Hafif sise 'mist', hafif sisli havaya 'misty' denir.

quiz.cloze: Drive carefully. It's so ______ that I can't see the car in front of me.

def.short: a unit for measuring how hot or cold something is
def.long: A unit that we use to say how hot or cold the air, water or a person is. We write it as a small circle after the number: 20°C.

examples.en: It's 30 degrees outside today.
examples.tr: Bugün dışarıda hava 30 derece.

examples.en: Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius.
examples.tr: Su 100 santigrat derecede kaynar.

examples.en: In Erzurum, it can be minus twenty degrees in January.
examples.tr: Erzurum'da ocak ayında hava eksi yirmi derece olabilir.

etymology.text: From Old French 'degré', from Latin 'de-' + 'gradus', meaning a step.

tr.note: Türkiye'de Celsius (°C) kullanılır; ABD'de Fahrenheit (°F) kullanılır. 30 °C yaklaşık 86 °F eder.

mistakes.why: Türkçede sayıdan sonra isim tekil kalır (30 derece). İngilizcede 1 dışındaki sayılardan sonra çoğul gerekir: 30 degrees, zero degrees.
Türkçede 'hava 30 derece' deriz. İngilizcede bu cümle 'it' ile kurulur ya da 'the temperature' denir; 'the weather' ile söylenmez.

quiz.cloze: The weather report says it will be 38 ______ in Antalya tomorrow. Very hot!

def.short: lower than the point where water turns into ice
def.long: Colder than the point where water turns into ice. In Celsius, it means a minus number, like minus five.

examples.en: The temperature is below zero today.
examples.tr: Bugün hava sıfırın altında.

examples.en: It was ten degrees below zero last night.
examples.tr: Dün gece sıcaklık sıfırın altında on dereceydi.

examples.en: When it's below zero, the roads get icy, so drive carefully.
examples.tr: Hava sıfırın altındayken yollar buz tutar, o yüzden dikkatli sür.

mistakes.wrong: It was five degrees under zero.
mistakes.right: It was five degrees below zero.
mistakes.why: Türkçedeki 'altında' yüzünden 'under' denir. Sıcaklık gibi ölçülerde 'below' kullanılır: below zero.

quiz.cloze: Water turns into ice when the temperature goes ______.

def.short: become covered with water, for example in the rain
def.long: To become covered with water or rain, so your clothes, hair or body are not dry. Use 'get' in the right tense: got wet, getting wet.

examples.en: Take an umbrella or you'll get wet.
examples.tr: Şemsiye al, yoksa ıslanırsın.

examples.en: We got wet on the way home because it started to rain.
examples.tr: Eve dönerken yağmur başladı ve ıslandık.

examples.en: Arda's shoes got wet when he walked through the snow.
examples.tr: Arda karda yürürken ayakkabıları ıslandı.

tr.note: Bir şeyi ıslatmak 'get something wet' olur: Don't get your phone wet.

quiz.cloze: It's raining hard and I don't have an umbrella. I'm going to ______.

def.short: lose daylight in the evening as the sun goes down
def.long: When the sun goes down and night starts, the sky loses its light. People usually say it with 'it': it gets dark early in winter.

examples.en: It's getting dark. Let's go home.
examples.tr: Hava kararıyor. Hadi eve gidelim.

examples.en: In winter, it gets dark at five o'clock.
examples.tr: Kışın hava saat beşte kararır.

examples.en: We have to put up the tent before it gets dark.
examples.tr: Hava kararmadan çadırı kurmalıyız.

tr.note: Sabah hava aydınlanınca 'get light' denir: In summer, it gets light at five.

mistakes.why: Türkçede 'hava kararıyor' deriz. İngilizcede 'weather' yağmur, güneş gibi durumlar içindir; kararmak için cümle 'it' ile kurulur.

quiz.cloze: Please turn on the light. I can't read my book because it's ______.
